title: The Obelisk That Would Not Cast Shadow
description: Aten Ra advances through sacred temple approach with shallow river-light lanes and low sandstone cover while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and battle line answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: sacred temple approach with shallow river-light lanes and low sandstone cover

objectives.primary: Hold two sun markers at the end of the same round.
optional: Keep all one active Titan standing
Trigger at least two faction synergy actions

specialRules: Battle line Light: adjacent Titans gain minor protection when ending near a solar tile.
Hollow Drift: basic enemies favor isolated Titans.
victoryConditions: Hold two sun markers at the end of the same round.

stars.one: Primary completed with the active Titan standing under severe turn pressure

activeTitanDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard one active Titan; nonstandard modes require explicit Creator approval.

tacticalProfile.rule: Recommended advantages only — any valid active Titan can attempt the mission.

activeTitanPolicy.rosterPurpose: Choose the best single Titan before launch; roster depth changes approach, not on-field body count.
